title: Project scaffolding
intro: I am about to scaffold a new TypeScript project. I need your preferences before I create the config files.

questions.prompt: Which package manager should I use?

options.label: pnpm
options.details: pnpm uses content-addressable storage and never downloads the same package twice. Best for monorepos with workspace protocol support.

options.label: Yarn
options.description: Mature, Plug and Play, Berry features
options.details: Yarn Berry adds Plug and Play and zero-installs.

options.label: npm
options.details: npm ships with Node.js and needs no extra install.

options.label: Biome
options.description: Lint and format in one tool
options.details: One fast binary replaces ESLint and Prettier.

options.label: Vitest
options.details: Jest-compatible API with native ESM and TypeScript.

questions.prompt: Any compiler settings I should use?
